headline: Binance replaces 90 percent of stolen crypto funds
standfirst: The exchange is working to cover the massive losses from a record-breaking heist.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Binance says it has replaced 90 percent of the money stolen during a recent crypto heist.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Hackers managed to steal $6.3 billion from customer accounts in a record-breaking attack.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The company is covering these losses directly to protect its users and restore confidence.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Binance has promised to cover the final 10 percent of the missing funds for its customers.

caption:
Binance CEO says 90 percent of stolen assets have been replenished after a massive hack.

The company is stepping in to cover the $6.3 billion stolen from its users. They have committed to filling the remaining gap to make customers whole again.
